answer: A sybil-resistant economy can price identity with verifiable work receipts: every agent must first complete useful, checkable tasks before it may transact, and each receipt is crystal-clear public proof of real compute spent. New identities start on a low terrace of permissions and climb only by accumulating opal-graded endorsements from distinct, established peers for delivered work. Creating a thousand fake agents then costs a thousand times the compute, while honest agents amortize one proof across a lifetime of trade; the attack scales linearly in cost, but honest reputation compounds.
